patterns.note: The site uses a dark mode aesthetic with a full-width layout, featuring large, distinct sections for portfolio items and textual content, all centered within the viewport.
Headings are set in a large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating strong visual hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text. The hero section features oversized, semi-transparent year text.
A predominantly dark background (#121212 or #000) provides a stark contrast for white text and vibrant, diverse accent colors used within individual portfolio project previews.

The initial hero section features a 3D character that scrolls out of view, while the large '2026 Portfolio' text scales down and moves upwards, eventually disappearing to reveal the main content grid below.
Portfolio items are presented as large, distinct cards or full-width sections, each with a small numerical identifier and project title, creating a clean, organized grid.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark theme with high contrast white text, using a deep charcoal or pure black as the primary background color.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top of the viewport, providing consistent access to main links.

The hero section utilizes a complex scroll-triggered animation (likely involving css-keyframes and potentially a video-hero) where a 3D element and large text dynamically transform and disappear as the user scrolls, revealing the main content below.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for section titles, with a massive, semi-transparent display font for the hero year, contrasting with smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with airy spacing in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of openness.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its dynamic, scroll-triggered hero animation featuring a 3D character and large, transforming text that elegantly gives way to the main content. The consistent dark mode combined with vibrant, project-specific accent colors creates a sophisticated and engaging visual experience that feels both minimal and bold.
